comparison.objective: Roll puff pastry into an even 3 mm sheet; unlike separating rigid finishing media from metal parts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual rolling-pin leveling and distributed deformation control versus granular pouring, agitation, and stable screen placement.
comparison.success_condition: Requires sheet length, 2.5–3.5 mm thickness coverage, evenness, and pin set-down; candidate requires recovered mass, retained washers, no contamination or loss, and release dwell. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: It is deformable thickness control, not rigid-body batch separation.
